measurement.estimand: MAD of local energy over complete draw-by-walker records from a fresh evaluation of a frozen checkpoint
measurement.complete_record_rule: every planned draw-by-walker record exactly once; finite coordinates and local energy; source, checkpoint, config, and schema identities reconcile; no clipping or replacement
measurement.checkpoint_window: fresh evaluation stream for each frozen checkpoint with declared burn-in, stride, walkers, draws, and evaluation seed
measurement.seed_identity_rule: training and evaluation seeds use separate namespaces and must be distinct

tail_rule.diagnostic: Hill estimator on upper tail of absolute median-centered local energy

proposal.stability_interval: operator-selected uncertainty interval wholly below alpha=2

tail_rule.when_present: use MAD, IQR, and quantiles as primary dispersion; variance and conventional MCSE descriptive only

decision_rules.recurrence: complete declared horizon/checkpoints; accepted tail handling; declared independent-lineage count shows early-to-middle decrease and middle-to-late increase in MAD beyond operator-approved margins, sustained at required late checkpoints
decision_rules.bounded_null: complete declared horizon/checkpoints; no lineage meets recurrence; every lineage remains within operator-approved bound relative to helium reference behavior
decision_rules.unresolved: any required identity, record, tail decision, checkpoint, threshold, or operator decision is absent, or evidence falls between the other rules

helium_reference_behavior_to_match.proposal: match only the He-v1 common-estimand tail-safe dispersion behavior after operator selects the exact reference window and margin

update_horizon_and_checkpoints.proposal: 50_000 updates with operator-selected early, middle, and late checkpoints

acceptable_tail_diagnostic.proposal: Hill diagnostic with operator-selected tail fraction, stability interval, and order-statistic minimum

controls: strict no-regularization rule at zero radius
